metadata.name: Command Palette
metadata.description: A command palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K) with fuzzy search, grouped results, matched letters underlined, and a preview pane that tilts with the cursor. Arrow keys, Home, End, Enter and Esc; combobox and listbox semantics.
